subject: Shit To Do in NYC (Sep 21): Sasha & Digweed all night, a basement boxing card
opener: Sasha and Digweed are doing an open-to-close at Knockdown on Friday, which is the closest thing to a Kx5 night you'll get this year. Around it: a basement boxing card in Tribeca on Thursday, a secret comedy room, and Timmy Regisford playing house in a garden on Sunday afternoon. The music desk came back empty this week, so this one is built off what the scene is actually posting.

picks.headline: Sasha and Digweed, open to close, Knockdown
picks.title: Sasha & John Digweed: All Night Long
picks.when: Fri Sep 25, 11pm to 5am, open to close
picks.why: This is the source code for everything you love: Prydz, deadmau5, Kx5 all come downstream of these two. Six hours, one booth, no festival slot nonsense, and the Main Hall is the room for it. Thirty-eight bucks for the night is absurd.
picks.heads_up: 11pm to 5am, 21+, about $38 on Dice. It's a real late one, so plan the Saturday around sleeping in and go in fresh rather than after four beers.
picks.invite_text: Sasha and John Digweed are doing an open-to-close set at Knockdown Friday night, 11 til 5. Tickets are like 38 bucks, I'm grabbing a few - in?

verification.note: Dice link would not fetch; RA event page (ra.co/events/2426901) states Fri, Sep 25, 2026, 23:00-05:00 at Knockdown Center, open-to-close set, so date/time/venue check out; Dice's own event and venue listings now show $43.32, not $38.

picks.headline: Fall Brawl at Church Street Boxing
picks.title: Church Street Boxing Presents "FALL BRAWL"
picks.price: tickets on Eventbrite; the price tier did not render on the page, so check before you commit (water and soda are $2 inside)
picks.why: A sanctioned card in the basement of one of the oldest gyms in the city, five minutes from where you teach Krav. You're close enough to hear the corners. Amateurs, so go for the room and the crowd, not the names.
picks.heads_up: Thursday 6:30 to 10pm, tickets via the gym's Eventbrite and the price tier didn't load on the page, so check before you commit. No outside food or booze; water and soda are $2 inside.
picks.invite_text: There's a boxing card in the basement at Church Street Boxing on Thursday, 6:30 start. Ringside in a hundred-year-old gym, I'm going straight from Tribeca - come meet me.

verification.note: Eventbrite page loaded: Thursday, September 24, 2026, 6:30 PM-10 PM at Church Street Boxing Gym, 25 Park Place; ticket price tier still does not render, only the $2 water/soda note appears.

picks.headline: Don't Tell Comedy, unmarked room in Chelsea
picks.title: Don't Tell Comedy — secret location, Chelsea
picks.venue: Secret location (revealed by 8am day of show)
picks.why: You still talk about that apartment comedy show in Midtown. This is the same trick: no lineup, no venue until the morning of, BYOB, five to seven comics in a room with folding chairs. You book on faith and you end up being the guy who knew about it.
picks.heads_up: Saturday 8:30pm, 21+. Address gets emailed by 8am that day, so don't make dinner plans on the other side of town. Bring your own bottle and a corkscrew.
picks.invite_text: Booked a secret comedy show Saturday at 8:30 - they don't tell you the address until that morning and it's BYOB. Grab a bottle and meet me in Chelsea.

verification.note: Don't Tell Comedy page loaded: Manhattan (Chelsea) Saturday September 26th, 8:30 p.m. show with doors at 8 p.m., general admission $30, BYOB, 21+, address emailed at 8 a.m. day of show.

picks.headline: Iris van Herpen talks and a drink, Brooklyn Museum
picks.title: Art History Happy Hour: Iris van Herpen, Sculpting the Senses
picks.price: $30, $18 members, includes a drink and exhibition access
picks.why: Thursday date night ten minutes from the house: a drink in hand, four smart people doing fifteen minutes each on couture, mathematics and materials science, then the run of the show. Polished without being a Manhattan production, and you're home at a reasonable hour.
picks.heads_up: Thursday 7 to 9pm, $30 ($18 if you're a member), includes one drink and exhibition access. These happy hours cap out, so buy ahead.
picks.invite_text: Thursday: drinks and short talks at the Brooklyn Museum on the Iris van Herpen show, 7 to 9. Thirty bucks and a drink included - want me to book two?

verification.note: The program page itself returned an access error, but the Brooklyn Museum's own site calendar lists Art History Happy Hour on September 24, 7-9 pm, and the program URL is the Iris van Herpen 'Sculpting the Senses' edition; the $30/$18-member price is the series standard but I could not re-read it for this date.

picks.headline: Timmy Regisford plays Shelter, 3pm Sunday
picks.title: Shelter: Timmy Regisford Open To Close
picks.when: Sun Sep 27, from 3pm, open to close
picks.why: Shelter is a genuine New York institution and he's playing open to close in the Public Records garden, outdoors, starting in daylight. This is the grown-up version of that BQE day party you loved. Done by dinner, no babysitter math.
picks.heads_up: From 3pm Sunday, tickets on Dice. It's outdoors, so watch the forecast, and one of the last good dance days of the year.
picks.invite_text: Timmy Regisford is playing open to close in the Public Records garden Sunday from 3pm. Outdoor house all afternoon and home by dinner - come through.

verification.note: Dice short link would not fetch; the Public Records venue calendar lists 'Presented by Public Records. Shelter: Timmy Regisford Open To Close' on Sunday, Sep 27 at 3:00PM with the same Dice link (a8bbb7e7fcac); price not shown.

picks.headline: Bushwig takes over three Bushwick rooms
picks.title: Bushwig Festival 2026
picks.when: Sat Sep 26 to Sun Sep 27, 4pm Saturday through 4am
picks.venue: 3 Dollar Bill / 9 Bob Note / The Yard
picks.why: You do drag at Phoenix with the guys; this is that at full scale, community-run, indoor and outdoor stages across three venues. It starts at 4pm, so you can do the good daylight hours and skip the part where it becomes a 3am problem.
picks.heads_up: Saturday 4pm through 4am, ticketing via the venue RSVP page. Go early for the outdoor stages and set a hard exit time before you go in.
picks.invite_text: Bushwig starts at 4pm Saturday across three rooms in Bushwick - drag, DJs, outdoor stages. Doing the daylight shift, come find me.

verification.note: 3 Dollar Bill's own page (despite the 9/27 slug) states Bushwig Festival 2026 runs Saturday, September 26, 2026 4:00 PM to Sunday, September 27, 2026 4:00 AM at 3 Dollar Bill/9 Bob Note/The Yard, 260 Meserole St; tickets via Etix, price not listed.

picks.headline: Smash burgers and a band at Strong Rope
picks.title: Jerry Pepper's smash burgers plus PK Drumz live music at Strong Rope
picks.when: Fri Sep 25, food pop-up 12pm-8pm; live music Friday evening
picks.venue: Strong Rope Brewery, Red Hook taproom (185 Van Dyke St)
picks.price: free entry; beer and burgers a la carte
picks.why: Your Red Hook taproom with an actual reason to be there: Jerry Pepper's slinging smash burgers and PK Drumz running live music. Free to walk in, no cover, and it's the perfect early half of Friday before Knockdown.
picks.heads_up: Friday evening, walk-in, food and beer a la carte. Eat here first, then head to Queens for the all-nighter. It's the Red Hook taproom, and Jerry Pepper's serves only until 8pm, so come before then for burgers.
picks.invite_text: Strong Rope has a smash burger pop-up and a live band Friday evening. Burgers and beer at 7, then Knockdown after if you're up for it.

verification.note: Strong Rope's events calendar lists both 'Food Pop-Up: Jerry Pepper's' and 'Live Music: PK Drumz Presents' on September 25, 2026; the Jerry Pepper's event page gives 12:00 PM-8:00 PM at 185 Van Dyke Street (Red Hook); the PK Drumz page would not load, so no set music start time is published.

anytime.headline: World Spa in Borough Park, book the venik
anytime.title: World Spa full-day banya session
anytime.when: Sun to Thu 10am to 10pm; Fri and Sat 9am to 11pm
anytime.why: The maxed-out version of your Russian bathhouse day: the largest Grand Banya in the country at 190-plus degrees with constant venik thrashing, plus hammams, onsen pools and a snow room. anytime.headline: Matches in Greenpoint: dinner that becomes a dance floor
anytime.title: Matches
anytime.when: dinner, then the tables get cleared and it turns into a bar with DJs
anytime.price: a la carte; burgers and steak frites, roughly a $40 to $60 dinner
anytime.why: Opened in August. Loaded cheeseburger, tallow fries, wagyu steak frites, then the tables come out and the room turns into a bar with DJs. No second venue, no re-convincing anyone at 11pm. Good three-guys Friday before anyone puts it on a list.

verification.note: Instagram is not fetchable, but The Infatuation's August 2026 review confirms Matches is open at 560 Manhattan Ave in Greenpoint (former Enid's space) serving steak frites, caesar and a burger with tallow fries, turning into a bar with DJs later; no menu prices verified.

family.headline: A band plays Dolly Parton for toddlers, Brooklyn Bowl
family.title: The Rock and Roll Playhouse plays the Music of Dolly Parton for Kids
family.why: Real venue, real band, real PA, and a Sunday late-morning slot that's done long before the nap that matters. The country streak in your library means you'll actually enjoy the set instead of enduring it. Room to let her crawl around.
family.heads_up: It's a 12:30pm show with noon doors, not a late-morning one.
family.invite_text: Sunday morning there's a live band playing Dolly Parton for toddlers at Brooklyn Bowl. Ends early, we can do lunch in Williamsburg after - want to go?

verification.note: Brooklyn Bowl's own event page lists The Rock and Roll Playhouse Plays Music of Dolly Parton for Kids on Sunday, September 27, 2026, doors 12:00 PM / show 12:30 PM, all ages, at 61 Wythe Ave; Ticketmaster shows $20-$23 with fees included.
